title: DHFWS Purba Bardhaman Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 27 Block Data Manager and Staff Nurse Posts
description: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti Purba Bardhaman (DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 27 Block Data Manager and Staff Nurse positions. Candidates who have qualified in GNM, B.Sc. Nursing, Any Degree, or Diploma can take advantage of this opportunity and apply for the DHFWS Purba Bardhaman Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for...
